newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kisan in tech tie-up with Swiss firm.
newsitem.headline: Kisan in tech tie-up with Swiss firm.

text.p: South Korea's Kisan Co said on Friday it had formed a technical tie-up with Swiss-based Thermoselect on waste burning and recycling systems.
Kisan said it would own exclusive rights for 20 years to make and sell in Korea and Southeast Asia the Swiss firm's "energy and raw material recovery systems".
A Kisan statement said the systems could sharply reduce air pollution to a level well below international standards.
Kisan's spokesman Lee Hyup-hee said the company expected sales from the new business to reach some 500 billion won by the end of this year and some 700 billion won next year.
